text:
maya: quick report: Go generator sample sometimes deadlocks when ctx is cancelled during an auth retry/backoff. managed to reduce to a small test.

jon: sounds similar to prior leaks. does Recv block on reading an io.Reader after cancel?

maya: yes. flow: GenerateStream(ctx) -> auth retry sleep -> cancel ctx -> Recv() never returns. the refresh path uses time.Sleep for backoff.

rachel: immediate fixes: 1) make backoff cancel-aware (select on ctx.Done()), 2) provide Stream.Cancel()/Interrupt() so callers can force-unblock Recv.

jon: API suggestion: add an optional interface so it's nonbreaking:
```go
type InterruptibleStream interface {
  Interrupt(err error) // unblocks Recv and returns err to callers
}
```
Keep GenerateStream(ctx, req) signature unchanged.

maya: also updating sampleapp README to show pattern: spawn goroutine that cancels/interrupts on ctx.Done instead of relying on defer cancel. small repro test will assert no goroutine leak.

ops-bot: created issue INF-5302: generator stream cancel ergonomics. linked CI flake: examples/generator-onboard timeout.

rachel: good plan. maya please attach PR with tests and sample changes, mark devex for docs review.

maya: will do, PR incoming. thanks :)
